text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training, I notice Air Groove
stumbling for
a moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You could say that—I went to bed later
than I
intended. The moon was so
beautiful, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I needn't go into that. Forget I said
anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine... I tried reading under the
moonlight and...
completely lost track of
the time.
choice_data_list: それだとかえって気になる
choice_data_list_en: Now that just makes me even more curious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But this is a problem of my own doing!
Now, let's
get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We return to training, but Air Groove
remains a
little off form.
